thread:
Ellen Park: Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem. Two failure modes: delayed consumer commits causing late ingests, and dedupe gaps when retries overlap. We need clear owners for (1) short-term mitigation, (2) backfill plan, and (3) customer credit workflow. Listing proposals below — please ACK and claim by EOD.

Marco Silva: ACK. I'll own the short-term mitigation: add a 2-minute post-deploy soft-throttle for metering writes and add a retry fingerprint ttl. Rolling to staging today.

Priya Rao: I'll own the customer credit workflow and invoice approvals. Need the dry-run CSV and an approval checklist.

Ken Zhou: I'll build the backfill job. Plan: compute canonical token totals per invoice window, write adjustment records (append-only) with job_run_id, and use k8s lease for leader-election. Backfill will run canary -> 50 -> full. ETA PR by 2026-01-08.

Yasmine Cortez: I'll add monitoring: token-rate drift alert (>25% deviation) and a dashboard showing commits vs processed counts.

BillingBot: NOTE: BILL-2366 opened — 53 invoices flagged. Suggested next steps: upload dry-run CSV, generate draft credit memos, and schedule customer comms.

Ellen Park: Owners & due dates (confirm):
- Marco Silva 
 short-term throttle + fingerprint ttl 
 due 2026-01-05
- Ken Zhou 
 backfill job + idempotent writes 
 due 2026-01-10
- Priya Rao 
 invoice dry-run + credits + comms 
 due 2026-01-12
- Yasmine Cortez 
 monitoring + alerting 
 due 2026-01-06
Please update BILL-2366 with PR links and completion times.

Marco Silva: Short note on mitigation: implemented request_fingerprint ttl=45s and a lightweight metric for duplicate fingerprint hits. Will post canary results.

Ken Zhou: Backfill sketch:
```
for batch in invoice_batches:
  if not try_acquire_lease(): continue
  canonical = compute_canonical(batch)
  diffs = compare_with_ledger(canonical)
  write_adjustments(diffs, id=sha256(invoice+window+job_run))
```
Will include dry-run and manual-approve options.

Priya Rao: Dry-run CSV expected to be uploaded to BILL-2366 by Ken. Once I have it, I'll prepare credit memos and a customer FAQ draft.

Yasmine Cortez: Added dashboard: /grafana/d/redwood/metering-anomaly; alert rule created. Will tune thresholds after canary.

Ellen Park: Two process items: (A) backfill must never mutate raw usage rows; always append adjustments, and (B) keep an audit table with operator, job_run_id, and signed checksum.

Marco Silva: Canary started on staging at 15:10 PT; no duplicate-fingerprint spikes in the 20-minute window. Posting logs to BILL-2366.

Ken Zhou: Uploaded dry-run CSV: /private/drive/BILL-2366/dryrun_2445001111.csv (53 rows). Running canary adjustments for top-5 invoices now.

Priya Rao: Received CSV. Draft credit memos ready, routing to legal for review. Will queue customer emails after legal OK.

Ellen Park: Thanks all. Sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to verify canary results and approve bulk backfill. If blockers surface, ping @Ellen. Closing thread till sync. :white_check_mark:
